OUR MISSION
Surya Sangam is on a mission to democratize access to clean energy by empowering every Indian household and institution to make informed, transparent, and confident solar decisions—backed by technology, verified information, & trusted partners.

WHO WE ARE
Every day, thousands of individuals and organizations across India seek to switch to solar energy—but face a fragmented, confusing, & often opaque process. That’s why we created Surya Sangam—India’s emerging end-to-end digital solar marketplace, developed to bring clarity, choice, and credibility to clean energy adoption.

Surya Sangam connects users with vetted solar vendors, certified installers, and financing partners who compete to deliver the best value. But our role goes beyond connections—we simplify the solar journey through real-time comparison tools, unbiased assistance, and digital tools for monitoring savings, performance, & emissions reduction.

WHAT WE DELIVER
Transparency: Real-time Verified quotes & solution comparisons across all factors.

Inclusion: Creating Green Jobs Space & Affordable access for all, including rural & underserved communities

Accountability: End-to-end support with verified installers, tracking, & post-sale service

Impact: Tools to quantify financial savings & carbon reduction in real-time

WE ARE GROWING
Surya Sangam is rapidly scaling across regions and building partnerships with purpose-driven organizations, climate-tech innovators, & government-aligned programs. We're always looking to collaborate with passionate individuals, vendors, and institutions to co-create a greener, solar-powered future.

Explore partnership or collaboration opportunities by visiting: https://www.suryasangam.com/aboutus

One of the biggest barriers to solar adoption isn’t always cost—it’s complexity.

Too many options. Too much fragmented information. Too many decisions being made in isolation.

Surya SmartHub was built around a simple idea: make the solar journey easier to navigate.

Instead of treating solar as a single transaction, SmartHub brings together evaluation, comparison, and decision support into a connected experience—helping users move from interest to informed action.

Because the future of clean energy adoption will depend not only on access to technology, but also on how intuitive we make the journey toward it. #SolarEnergy #RenewableEnergy #CleanEnergy #EnergyTransition #SolarIndia #DigitalTransformation #SuryaSmartHub #SuryaSangam

The most valuable part of a solar project often happens before installation begins.

The consultation.

Businesses today are asking more thoughtful questions than ever before—not just about pricing, but about electricity economics, long-term value, servicing expectations, infrastructure planning, and whether a system will continue delivering performance 20–25 years down the line.

That’s why Surya Sangam approaches consultations as decision sessions, not sales conversations. Through rooftop visualization, generation estimates, financial discussions, and deployment planning, the goal is to help users understand not only what can be installed—but what should be installed.

Because successful solar adoption isn’t driven by lower costs alone. It’s driven by informed decisions. #SolarEnergy #CommercialSolar #RenewableEnergy #EnergyTransition #Infrastructure #CleanEnergy #Sustainability #SuryaSangam

Solar adoption is often viewed as a single milestone: installation.

In reality, it’s a much broader journey—one that begins with understanding feasibility and continues through financing, deployment, and long-term performance.

That’s the ecosystem Surya Sangam is building.

Through tools like SuryaCalc, users can begin with data-driven evaluation and understand solar potential before making investment decisions. Financing pathways help reduce barriers to adoption. Deployment planning focuses on designing solutions around actual energy needs rather than one-size-fits-all systems. And the journey continues through advisory, visualization, and long-term operational thinking.

Because successful solar transition isn’t just about putting panels on a rooftop.
It’s about making informed decisions at every stage.

At Surya Sangam, our goal is to make that journey simpler, more structured, and more accessible—from first evaluation to long-term value creation. #SolarEnergy #CommercialSolar #RenewableEnergy #EnergyTransition #CleanEnergy #Sustainability #SolarIndia #SuryaSangam

Commercial solar decisions often begin with one question: “How much will installation cost?”

But the better question is: “What does the data say?”

Before committing capital, businesses need visibility into what actually makes sense for their operations—system sizing, generation potential, expected savings, and overall financial impact.

That’s where SuryaCalc comes in.

SuryaCalc helps translate electricity consumption into actionable solar insights, giving businesses a first-level understanding of their solar opportunity before moving into deployment decisions.

Because commercial solar isn’t about installing the biggest possible system—it’s about identifying the right fit for your energy demand, roof potential, and business goals.

The more informed the decision, the more sustainable the outcome. #CommercialSolar #SolarEnergy #EnergyTransition #RenewableEnergy #BusinessStrategy #SolarIndia #EnergyEfficiency #SuryaCalc #SuryaSangam

A residential solar project and a commercial solar project may receive the same amount of sunlight—but the decisions behind them are completely different.

For homeowners, the focus is often on reducing monthly electricity expenses and understanding payback periods.

For businesses, the conversation shifts toward operating costs, ROI, cash flow, and long-term energy planning.

That distinction is exactly why SuryaCalc was built. By evaluating consumption patterns, roof potential, system sizing, and projected savings, it helps users start with data—not assumptions.

The right solar solution isn’t universal. It’s contextual. #SolarEnergy #CommercialSolar #ResidentialSolar #RenewableEnergy #EnergyTransition #Sustainability #SolarIndia #SuryaCalc #SuryaSangam

paragraphs: At Surya Sangam, we recognize that our vendors and partners play a critical role in our mission to drive sustainable innovation and deliver clean energy solutions. This policy applies to all vendors, suppliers, contractors, and consultants providing goods or services to Surya Sangam, either directly or indirectly.

Empowering Homeowners with Solar Energy Independence

In today's economic climate, managing household expenses is more critical than ever. One of the most significant and unpredictable costs for homeowners is electricity. At Surya Sangam, we are committed to providing a strategic, long-term solution that offers more than just power, it offers control.

Our solar solutions empower homeowners to break free from the cycle of rising electricity bills. By investing in a Surya Sangam system, they secure a stable and predictable energy cost, enhancing their financial stability and increasing their property's value. This is not just a home improvement project; it's a strategic financial decision.

We are proud to serve the Ghaziabad community and help residents take charge of their energy future with our simple, swift, and smart solar installations. This approach aligns with broader trends toward sustainability and smart resource management.

Learn how solar can transform your home's energy profile. 🌞 Rethinking Land Use in India’s Solar Mega Projects: Saaura vs. Traditional Panels
India is investing heavily in solar mega-projects, like the Khavda Renewable Energy Park in Gujarat, expected to generate 30,000 MW of power over 72,600 hectares.
Here’s the reality:
Traditional Solar Panels:
Land required: ~72,600 hectares
Sunlight capture: Fixed-tilt panels → lose energy as sun moves
Maintenance: High water usage and cleaning costs
Efficiency: ~15–18% real-world output
Saaura Power Tubes:
Land required: ~24,000 hectares for same 30,000 MW (3x less space)
Sunlight capture: 360° design → max energy capture from sunrise to sunset
Maintenance: Water-free and minimal cleaning
Efficiency: Up to 2x more energy per unit area
💡 By adopting Saaura’s Power Tube for large-scale projects, India could:
Save ~48,000 hectares of land — equivalent to the size of Mumbai city
Reduce water usage drastically
Achieve higher energy yield without expanding land or infrastructure
Innovation isn’t just about technology — it’s about using resources smarter. Saaura is making solar compact, efficient, and truly sustainable. #SolarEnergy #CleanTech #RenewableEnergy #Saaura #Sustainability #EnergyEfficiency #IndiaSolar #SolarInnovation

Already crowned India’s cleanest city for eight years in a row, Indore city in Madhya Pradesh has now added another ‘green’ feather in its cap, as it has become the country’s first city that will receive supply of drinking water using electricity from a solar power plant, which has been built mainly through funds generated by sale of green bonds on the stock exchange.
 
The solar energy plant, set up by the Indore Municipal Corporation (IMC), is scheduled to begin functioning from November this year. The electricity generated from it would be used to operate pumps to supply drinking water from the Narmada River to Indore city.
 
The unit would generate enough power to efficiently enable the pumps to supply water to Indore city, located at a distance of more than 80 km from the solar power plant, which is in Jalud village in the Maheshwar Tehsil of neighbouring Khargone district.
 
According to Indore Mayor Pushyamitra Bhargava, the plant was launched to promote renewable energy and reduce the power expenditure of the Narmada water project, and it is now almost complete.
 
“Of the total project cost of Rs 308 crore, IMC raised Rs 244 crore through a public issue of green bonds, making it the country’s first renewable energy unit financed in this manner”, Bhargava informed.
 
He said that the sale of green bonds attracted investors from across the country.
 
He pointed out that the solar power plant would also reduce the IMC’s monthly electricity bill for supplying drinking water to Indore households. #WaterSupply #WaterShortage #WaterSecurity #Energy #Environment #GreenBonds This content is prepared by ripple2wave . Rajasthan is moving ahead with 𝗩𝗶𝗿𝘁𝘂𝗮𝗹 𝗡𝗲𝘁 𝗠𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 (𝗩𝗡𝗠) and 𝗚𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗽 𝗡𝗲𝘁 𝗠𝗲𝘁𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗻𝗴 (𝗚𝗡𝗠) — which is fantastic news for households and government connections. A big win for solar adoption!
